blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
End-to-end multi-object trackers have narrowed the gap with classical tracking-by-detection on association-difficult benchmarks. Yet they still make spatially implausible errors no classical tracker would, such as assigning one identity to objects on opposite sides of the frame. A model could learn to avoid them, but tracking annotations are scarce, so we encode spatial priors explicitly instead, while keeping inference fully end-to-end with no post-hoc association.
  We propose three spatial priors, at the data, loss, and representation stages. Spatial ID Switches bias trajectory permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, reducing the mismatch between training and inference confusions. Spatial ID Loss scales each identity's penalty by its box distance, so a distant switch costs more than a nearby one. Spatial Anchor gives each track token its frame position, an explicit spatial cue for attention.
  We instantiate the three priors in MOTIP2, a tracker adapted from MOTIP and built on the real-time DEIM detection transformer. Trained without extra data, its main model, MOTIP2-L, sets a new state of the art: 73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack, 76.0 on SportsMOT, and 71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2 is a family of models spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off: a lighter model, MOTIP2-S, matches the original MOTIP at over 3x the speed, and MOTIP2-X reaches 74.8 HOTA on DanceTrack.
blocks.zh:
端对端多对象跟踪器在关联-困难基准上缩小了与古典跟踪逐项检测的差距. 然而,它们仍然在空间上造成任何古典追踪器都无法相信的错误,例如将一个身份分配给位于框架两侧的物体。 一个模型可以学会避免它们,但跟踪说明很少,所以我们明确地编码空间前科,同时保持完全的推断端到端,没有后热关联.
我们建议在数据、损失和表示阶段进行三个空间前科。 空间ID切换使轨迹向空间重叠物体倾斜,减少了训练和推论混淆之间的不匹配. 空间ID丢失按其箱位距离衡量每个身份的罚分,所以远端的开关比附近的开关花费更多. Space Anchor给每个音轨标志它的帧位置,一个清晰的空间提示来引起注意.

blocks.en: Two recurring failure types, however, share one cause: association without spatial grounding. In the first, two distant boxes in consecutive frames, with no occlusion between them, are assigned the same identity (see Appendix D ), a failure rare in classical trackers, whose motion gating makes such jumps expensive. In the second, the tracker swaps identities when objects cross or occlude. Neither is constrained by geometry: the cross-entropy penalizes an implausible cross-frame jump no more than an adjacent mistake, and training barely exposes the model to the nearby confusions where association is genuinely ambiguous. The association step needs an explicit spatial prior.
blocks.zh: 然而,两种重复出现的故障类型有一个原因:没有空间地面的关联。 在第一个中,两个连续框中的远箱,它们之间没有隔离,它们被分配到相同的身份(见附录D),这是古典追踪器中罕见的失败,其运动斑点使得这样的跳跃变得昂贵. 在第二个中,在物体交叉或吞噬时,跟踪器交换身份. 也不受几何学的制约:交叉纵横会惩罚一个无法相信的跨框跳跃,不过只是相邻的错误,训练几乎不会让模型暴露在附近的混乱中,因为联系是真正模糊不清的. 关联步骤需要明确的空间前置.

blocks.en: Tracking-by-detection encodes such constraints for free, as hand-crafted heuristics that need no training data: Kalman motion, IoU cost, and overlap-gated re-identification each forbid an association the moment it becomes spatially implausible [ Wojke et al.(2017)Wojke, Bewley, and Paulus , Aharon et al.(2022)Aharon, Orfaig, and Bobrovsky ] . End-to-end trackers discard these components and leave the attention mechanism to learn the same constraints from data. But annotated tracking data is scarce, so these constraints are learned imperfectly, and the tracker makes the implausible associations they would have prevented.
blocks.zh: 跟踪-逐项检测将这种限制免费编码,如不需要培训数据的手工制作的heuristics:Kalman Movement, IoU成本,以及重叠式的重新识别,每个都禁止一个协会在空间上变得不可信的那一刻[Wojke等人(2017年)Wojke,Bewley,以及Paulus, Aharon等人(2022年)Aharon, Orfaig,和Bobrovsky]. 端到端跟踪器丢弃这些组件,并留下关注机制从数据中学习相同的制约. 但附加注释的跟踪数据很少,因此这些限制是被不完美地学习的,跟踪者使得他们本会阻止的不可信的关联.

blocks.en: We propose three explicit spatial priors to tackle both failures, one each at the data, loss, and representation stage, all encoding one bias: spatial proximity should govern association. At the data stage, Spatial ID Switches target the dominant occlusion confusions. MOTIP exposes its decoder to such errors by shuffling historical identities at random, but a random shuffle mostly fabricates long-range swaps that rarely occur at inference, while barely sampling the nearby occlusions that cause most errors. We instead bias permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, so augmented histories mirror the confusions the tracker actually encounters. This trains the decoder to look further back in the tracklet to disambiguate when nearby objects are present, rather than blindly trusting the most recent assignment ( Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出三个明确的空间前科,以应对两种失败,在数据、损失和代表阶段各一个,都编码了一个偏差:空间接近应制约关联。 在数据阶段,Space ID Switchs针对的是占支配地位的隔离混淆. MOTIP通过随机洗刷历史身份,使其解码器暴露于此类错误中,但随机洗涤大多是编织出在推论中很少发生的长程互换,而几乎不取样造成大多数错误的附近隐蔽物. 相反,我们偏向于空间重叠的物体,因此,增加的历史反映了跟踪器实际遇到的混乱。 这训练解码器在轨迹中再往后看,当附近物体出现时会分解,而不是盲目地相信最近的任务(图4).

blocks.en: At the loss stage, the Spatial ID Loss targets the distant jump by restoring the geometric cost the cross-entropy leaves out. At the representation stage, the Spatial Anchor ties each track token to its frame position, a dedicated channel through which geometry enters association, so the model discriminates between candidates by where they are rather than only penalizing incoherent associations after the fact. Unlike the heuristic stack, these priors add no hand-crafted matching at test time, leaving inference free of any post-hoc association module.
blocks.zh: 在失落阶段,空间ID丢失通过恢复几何学成本来瞄准远处的跳跃. 在代表阶段,空间锚地将每个音轨符号与其框架位置联系起来,这是几何学进入关联的专用通道,因此该模型在候选人之间有所区别,因为候选人所在之处,而不是仅仅惩罚事后的不一致的社团. 与Heuristic堆栈不同,这些前科在测试时没有添加手动匹配,使得推论中没有任何后热结合模块.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Tracking-by-detection pipelines [ Bewley et al.(2016)Bewley, Ge, Ott, Ramos, and Upcroft , Wojke et al.(2017)Wojke, Bewley, and Paulus , Zhang et al.(2022)Zhang, Sun, Jiang, Yu, Weng, Yuan, Luo, Liu, and
Wang , Cao et al.(2023)Cao, Pang, Weng, Khirodkar, and Kitani , Aharon et al.(2022)Aharon, Orfaig, and Bobrovsky ] pair a frame-level detector [ Ge et al.(2021)Ge, Liu, Wang, Li, and Sun ] with a small, hand-designed association stack: a Kalman filter [ Kalman(1960) ] propagates each track forward, IoU cost penalizes implausible jumps, and Hungarian matching [ Kuhn(2010) ] resolves the assignment. When appearance is added via a re-identification network [ Wojke et al.(2017)Wojke, Bewley, and Paulus , Zhang et al.(2021b)Zhang, Wang, Wang, Zeng, and
Liu , Wang et al.(2020)Wang, Zheng, Liu, Li, and Wang , Aharon et al.(2022)Aharon, Orfaig, and Bobrovsky , Yang et al.(2024)Yang, Han, Yan, Zhang, Qi, Lu, and Wang ] , its score is gated by motion or overlap rather than consulted in isolation. Every component carries an explicit spatial prior, and the association module itself has essentially no learned parameters; this kept the pipeline competitive while annotated tracking data stayed scarce. These pipelines also commonly delay committing tentative tracks until they are observed across several consecutive frames [ Wojke et al.(2017)Wojke, Bewley, and Paulus ] , a tracklet-confirmation mechanism that prior query-based trackers have not adopted. The stack fails when crowding makes these geometric priors ambiguous: motion gating and IoU cost both lose their discriminative power as the IoU between an object’s consecutive observations collapses toward the inter-object IoU with its neighbors. This limitation motivated learned association.

Feichtenhofer , Zeng et al.(2022)Zeng, Dong, Zhang, Wang, Zhang, and Wei ] inherit DETR’s set-prediction formulation and add temporal association by propagating object queries across frames. MOTR [ Zeng et al.(2022)Zeng, Dong, Zhang, Wang, Zhang, and Wei ] formalizes this as a fully end-to-end framework, but the decoder it shares between detection and association creates a supervision conflict that MOTRv2 [ Zhang et al.(2023b)Zhang, Wang, and Zhang ] , MOTRv3 [ Yu et al.(2023)Yu, Wang, Li, Zhang, Zhang, and Tao ] , and CO-MOT [ Yan et al.(2025)Yan, Luo, Zhong, Gan, and Ma ] address through query-specific supervision or external proposals. MOTIP [ Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, and Wang ] resolves the conflict architecturally: a dedicated ID decoder predicts identity labels from the detector’s outputs, decoupling the two tasks and enabling scalable training, with trajectory-level identity permutations as the main association augmentation. The ID decoder, however, consumes only the detector’s content embeddings: the explicit per-query anchor that DAB-DETR and its successors introduced inside the detector is not carried through to association, leaving the module to recover spatial coherence from content alone. FDTA [ Shao et al.(2025)Shao, Yang, Yu, Li, Guo, Yan, Wang, and Sun ] , also building on MOTIP, instead learns more discriminative object embeddings for association and is our primary baseline ( Sec. 4.2 ). Transformer trackers also remain substantially slower than tracking-by-detection, a gap that FastTrackTr [ Liao et al.(2026)Liao, Yang, Wu, Yu, Li, and Zhang ] begins to close. Concurrent work raises end-to-end association accuracy through segmentation-driven tracking built on foundation models [ Jiang et al.(2026)Jiang, Wang, Zhao, Li, and Jiang ] , a direction complementary to the spatial priors we introduce. Our work targets both gaps, spatial grounding and speed: we restore the missing spatial prior at three stages of the association pipeline (data, loss, representation) on a real-time DEIM backbone.

blocks.en: 3 Spatial Priors for ID Association
blocks.zh: 3 身份证协会的空间前科

blocks.en: We first present MOTIP2, our end-to-end tracker adapted from MOTIP [ Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, and Wang ] , together with modifications to its detector and ID decoder ( Sec. 3.1 , Fig. 2 ). We then instantiate the three spatial priors announced in Sec. 1 , each acting at a different stage of the tracker: Spatial ID Switches at the data stage ( Sec. 3.2 ), the Spatial ID Loss at the loss stage ( Sec. 3.3 ), and Spatial Anchor at the representation stage ( Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先介绍了MOTIP2,我们从MOTIP[Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, 和Wang]改编的端到端跟踪器,以及对其探测器和ID解码器的修改(Sec. 3.1, 图2)。 然后,我们即时分析第1节中宣布的三个空间前科,每个空间前科在跟踪器的不同阶段运作:数据阶段的空间ID开关(第3.2节),损失阶段的空间ID丢失(第3.3节),以及代表阶段的空间锁定(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview: MOTIP2
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览:中期投资方案2

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of MOTIP2. DEIM produces detection embeddings independently per frame. Three explicit spatial priors then inject geometric structure at distinct stages: (i) Spatial ID Switches perturb the training-time historical context by GIoU-biased identity permutations that mirror the near-track confusions seen at inference; (ii) Spatial ID Loss supervises the ID decoder with a geometric penalty; (iii) Spatial Anchor carries each detection’s positional encoding into the ID decoder, so every token holds an explicit cue to its image position.
blocks.zh: 图2: MOTIP2. DEIM每个帧独立产生检测嵌入. 三个明确的空间前身然后在不同的阶段注入几何结构:(一) 空间ID开关干扰了训练时间的历史背景,通过GIOU偏重的特性布局来反映在推论中看到的近轨混乱;(二) 空间ID丢失用几何惩罚来监督ID解码器;(三) 空间锁定器将每个探测器的位置编码输入ID解码器,因此每个标志都对其图像位置有一个明确的提示。

blocks.en: MOTIP2 follows MOTIP [ Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, and Wang ] , which we briefly recap; readers familiar with it can skip to the changes. MOTIP decouples detection from identity prediction within a single end-to-end tracker. A detection transformer processes each frame independently, producing detection embeddings 𝐞 i \mathbf{e}_{i} with bounding boxes b ^ i \hat{b}_{i} . During training, bipartite matching assigns each prediction to a ground-truth object with identity label y i y_{i} , as in DETR; a dedicated ID decoder then cross-attends over a historical context of the last T T frames and predicts, for each detection, a distribution over an ID dictionary of K + 1 K{+}1 learnable identity embeddings ( K K active identities plus a newborn class). The model is trained end-to-end on short clips sampled at random frame rates, jointly optimizing the detector and the ID decoder. At inference the video is processed online: each frame’s assigned embeddings are appended to the context, maintained as a FIFO buffer of size T T , and a greedy protocol turns the predicted distributions into unique identity assignments.
blocks.zh: MOTIP2如下 MOTIP [Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, 和Wang],我们简短地总结一下;熟悉它的读者可以跳过变化. MOTIP在单一端对端跟踪器内从身份预测中解析检测. 一个检测变压器会独立处理每个帧,产生检测嵌入 e i\ mathbf{e}_{i} 并带有边框 b ^ i\ hat{b}_{i}. 在训练期间,双方匹配将每个预测分配到一个带有身份标签y i y_{i}的地面真人对象,如DETR;一个专用的ID解码器然后跨过上一个T帧的历史背景,并预测每次检测时,在K+1K{+}1可学习身份嵌入的ID字典上分布(KK活动身份加新生儿类). 该模型在以随机帧速率抽取的短片片上接受端到端的训练,共同优化了探测器和ID解码器. 推论视频是在线处理的:每个帧的指定嵌入物都附在上下文中,作为大小为T T的FIFO缓冲器维护,一个贪婪的协议将预测的分布变为独特的身份任务.

blocks.en: Throughout, end-to-end means no post-hoc association module rather than no tracking logic at inference: the greedy readout and the tracklet confirmation below manage track lifecycles, with no matching stage between separately produced detections and tracks. Beyond the three spatial priors that motivate this work ( Secs. 3.2 , 3.3 and 3.4 ), our changes are confined to the detector, the ID decoder, and the training objective, described next; everything else above is inherited unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在整个过程中,端对端意味着没有后热联动模块,而不是在推断时没有跟踪逻辑:贪婪的读出和下面的轨道确认管理着轨迹生命周期,在单独生成的检测和轨迹之间没有匹配阶段. 除了推动这项工作的三个空间前科(第3.2、3.3和3.4条)之外,我们的变化仅限于探测器、ID解码器和培训目标,下文对此作了介绍;上面所有其它东西的继承保持不变。

blocks.en: We replace MOTIP’s Deformable DETR detector [ Zhu et al.(2021)Zhu, Su, Lu, Li, Wang, and Dai ] with the real-time detector DEIM [ Huang et al.(2025)Huang, Lu, Cun, Yu, Zhou, and Shen ] . Profiling shows that over 80% of MOTIP’s inference cost comes from the detector ( Tab. 4 ), making it the primary target for acceleration. Selecting different DEIM backbone and decoder configurations instantiates a family of models (N/S/M/L/X): even the high-capacity X variant matches MOTIP’s speed while being more accurate, and lighter variants cut latency further.
blocks.zh: 我们取代了MOTIP的变形DETR探测器[Zhu等人(2021)Zhu, 苏 鲁 李,王,戴)与实时探测器DEIM[黄等人(2025年) 韩, 鲁,昆 余, 周, 及沈 〕 分析表明,MOTIP的推论成本有80%以上来自探测器(表4),使其成为加速的首要目标。 选择不同的DEIM主干线和解码器配置,即时将一组模型(N/S/M/L/X):即使是高容量的X变体也符合MOTIP的速度,同时更加精确,更轻的变体进一步削减了耐久性.

blocks.en: We keep MOTIP’s ID decoder with two structural changes. First, we fuse detection features and identity embeddings by element-wise addition rather than concatenation, halving the hidden dimension to match the DETR decoder; we double the feed-forward network (FFN) ratio to preserve capacity. Second, we replace MOTIP’s learned discrete temporal attention bias with rotary position embeddings (RoPE) [ Su et al.(2024)Su, Ahmed, Lu, Pan, Bo, and Liu ] applied inside the query–key product, so attention between two tokens varies with their frame offset. RoPE enables context-window extension at inference beyond the training length [ Chen et al.(2023)Chen, Wong, Chen, and Tian ] ; because training samples clips at variable frame rates while inference runs at a fixed stride, we rescale the RoPE timescale at inference by a factor α \alpha to match the average training timescale. Finally, at inference we add a lightweight tracklet-confirmation step absent from MOTIP: a track is confirmed only after N init = 2 N_{\text{init}}{=}2 consecutive consistent assignments, and unconfirmed tracks are discarded with their dictionary slots freed.
blocks.zh: 我们保留MOTIP的ID解码器, 首先,我们通过元素加成而不是加成嵌入引信检测特征和身份,将隐藏的维度减半,以与DETR解码器相匹配;我们为保持容量,将向导网络的比例增加一倍。 第二,我们用旋转位置嵌入物(ROPE)取代MOTIP所学得的离散时间注意力偏差[Su等人(2024年)Su, Ahmed, 鲁,潘, Bo,和Liu]在查询-键产品内部应用,因此两个符符之间的注意力随其帧偏移而变化. ROPE使上下文窗口扩展在培训时间之外[Chen等人(2023)Chen, 黄 Chen, and Tian];因为训练样本的剪辑以可变帧速率进行,而推论则以固定的步调进行,所以我们在推论中将ROPE时间尺度重新缩放为系数α\α,以匹配平均训练时间尺度. 最后,我们推论在 MOTIP 中添加一个轻量级的田径确认步骤:一个田径只在 N init = 2 NQQText{init}}{=}2 连续一致的任务之后确认,未经证实的田径被丢弃在他们的字典插槽中.

blocks.en: 3.2 Spatial ID Switches
blocks.zh: 3.2 空间身份证开关

blocks.en: Because bipartite matching assigns each token to its ground-truth identity, the training-time historical context is, by construction, perfectly consistent. At inference, however, noisy detections and occlusions cause identity ambiguities. To bridge this gap, MOTIP [ Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, and Wang ] perturbs the training context with an ID-switch augmentation that selects a random subset of objects in each frame and permutes their identities among themselves. The ID decoder thus learns to recover from confusions rather than overfitting to a perfect history.
blocks.zh: 由于双方配对为其地面真实身份分配了每个标志,因此从建筑上看,培训时间的历史背景是完全一致的。 然而,根据推论,噪音探测和隔离会造成身份模糊。 为了弥补这一差距,MOTIP [Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, 和Wang]用一个ID开关增强来扰动训练环境,在每一帧中选择一个随机的子集对象,并在它们彼此间固定它们的身份. ID解码器因此学会从混乱中恢复,而不是过度适应一个完美的历史.

blocks.en: Genuine confusions, however, are local: they arise between nearby objects under occlusion or close passage. Objects on opposite sides of the frame are never genuinely ambiguous, yet a uniform permutation, blind to geometry, fabricates mostly these long-range pairings while under-sampling the nearby confusions that cause most errors.
blocks.zh: 然而,真正的混淆是局部的:它们出现在附近物体之间,在隐蔽或近通过下. 架面对面的物体从来不是真正模糊的,然而一个统一的布置,对几何学视而不见,造型大多是这些长距离的配对,同时对附近引起大多数错误的混乱进行不足采样.

Chen , Huang et al.(2025)Huang, Lu, Cun, Yu, Zhou, and Shen ] is built on explicit spatial grounding: each query is a 4D anchor box, refined layer by layer, and a positional encoding 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} (a learned embedding of the final-layer box) steers cross-attention toward the relevant image region at every decoder step. At the handoff to the ID decoder, however, only the content embedding 𝐞 i \mathbf{e}_{i} is carried forward; 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} is dropped, leaving the decoder to perform association without any explicit cue about where on the frame each track sits, despite this information being available one stage upstream.

blocks.en: End-to-end training could let 𝐞 i \mathbf{e}_{i} encode location implicitly, but only entangled with appearance and re-learned from scratch, whereas the detector already computes this cue explicitly. We reuse it directly.
blocks.zh: 端到端的训练可以让 e i\ mathbf{e}_{i} 隐含地编码位置, 但只能与外观缠绕, 从头开始重新学习, 而探测器已经明确计算此提示 。 我们直接重用它。

blocks.en: We retain 𝐩 i \mathbf{p}_{i} at this handoff: it is added to each detection token as it enters the ID decoder, so every track carries its frame position, taken from its frame of origin, into association. Position then travels with the content embedding through the decoder’s attention and feed-forward layers, an explicit spatial signal the model would otherwise have to recover from appearance alone.
blocks.zh: 我们在此交接时保留 p i\ mathbf{p}_{i} : 当它进入ID解码器时, 它被添加到每个检测符上, 所以每个音轨都带有它的帧位置, 从它的起始框中提取, 连接起来 。 然后通过解码器的注意层和向导层内嵌内容进行定位,否则该模型就必须从外观中恢复一个明确的空间信号。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We first describe the training data and evaluation protocol, then compare with state-of-the-art methods across benchmarks spanning varied tracking regimes ( Sec. 4.2 ), analyze the speed-accuracy trade-off across model sizes ( Sec. 4.3 ), and finally isolate each contribution through an ablation study on PersonPath22 and DanceTrack ( Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述培训数据和评价协议,然后与跨越不同追踪制度的基准的最新方法进行比较(第4.2节),分析模型大小之间的速度精确性权衡(第4.3节),最后通过对PersonPath22和DanceTrack(第4.4节)的研究,将每项贡献分开。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on three benchmarks that stress different facets of association: DanceTrack [ Sun et al.(2022)Sun, Cao, Jiang, Yuan, Bai, Kitani, and
Luo ] (similar appearance with complex non-linear motion), SportsMOT [ Cui et al.(2023)Cui, Zeng, Zhao, Yang, Wu, and Wang ] (fast non-linear motion in team sports), and PersonPath22 [ Shuai et al.(2022)Shuai, Bergamo, Büchler, Berneshawi, Boden,
and Tighe ] (large-scale, diverse real-world scenes). We train one model per benchmark on its own training split, additionally co-training the PersonPath22 model with CrowdHuman [ Shao et al.(2018)Shao, Zhao, Li, Xiao, Yu, Zhang, and Sun ] . We report MOTIP2-L as our default variant for state-of-the-art comparisons unless otherwise specified, with MOTIP2-S used for ablations ( Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparisons with State-of-the-art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新技术的比较 方法

blocks.en: We compare MOTIP2 with state-of-the-art methods on the DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and PersonPath22 test splits, each using the corresponding model described above.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了MOTIP2与DanceTrack,SportsMOT,和PersonPath22的测试分数上最先进的方法,每个分数都使用上述相应的模型.

blocks.en: DanceTrack stresses association under near-identical appearance and highly non-linear motion, the regime where learned association should help most ( Tab. 1 ). Trained on DanceTrack alone, our default MOTIP2-L already reaches 73.4 \mathbf{73.4} HOTA, above the strongest prior end-to-end method (FDTA, 71.7 71.7 ) and every tracking-by-detection tracker. The larger MOTIP2-X raises this to 74.8 74.8 HOTA, 84.3 84.3 DetA, 66.5 66.5 AssA, and 78.7 78.7 IDF1, the best of any method trained without extra data; its HOTA surpasses even the extra-data FDTA † ( 74.4 74.4 ). Disabling all three priors while keeping every other component isolates their contribution: MOTIP2-L drops to 71.5 71.5 HOTA, below FDTA, and MOTIP2-X to 72.7 72.7 , losing 3.2 3.2 and 3.5 3.5 AssA while DetA moves by at most 0.2 0.2 . The margin over prior end-to-end trackers is therefore associative, not an effect of the DEIM detector. Training additionally on the validation split (the † \dagger extra-data protocol) lifts both variants further, with MOTIP2-X † setting a new overall state of the art at 77.1 \mathbf{77.1} HOTA, 85.4 85.4 DetA, 69.8 69.8 AssA, and 81.2 81.2 IDF1 (MOTIP2-L † reaches 76.1 76.1 HOTA).
blocks.zh: DanceTrack强调在近乎相同的外观和高度非线性运动下的关联,即学习型关联应该帮助最多的制度(Tab. 1 ) 。 仅在DanceTrack上接受过训练,我们默认的MOTIP2-L已经达到73.4\mathbf{73.4}HOTA, 高于最强的前端对端方法(FDTA, 71.7 71.7)和每个逐端跟踪跟踪跟踪器。 较大的MOTIP2-X将这一数值提高到74.8 74.8 HOTA、84.3 84.3 DetA、66.5 66.5 AssA和78.7 7 IDF1,这是任何没有额外数据的培训方法中最好的方法;其HOTA甚至超过了外数据FDTA(74.74.4)。 取消所有三个前科,同时保留所有其他组件,孤立其贡献: MOTIP2-L降至71.5 71.5 HOTA,低于FDTA,MOTIP2-X降至72.7 72.7,损失3.2 3.2和3.5 3.5 AssA,而DetA移动最多0.2 0.2. 因此,前端对端跟踪器的比值具有关联性,而不是DEIM探测器的效果. 此外,关于验证分拆的培训(o\dagger extra-data protocol)进一步提升了两个变体,MOTIP2-X 确定新的总技术状态为77.1\mathbf{77.1}HOTA、85.485.4 DetA、69.8 69.8 AssA和81.2 81.2 IDF1(MOTIP2-L †达到76.1 76.1 HOTA)。

blocks.en: Both variants keep gaining under the extra-data protocol ( + 2.3 +2.3 for MOTIP2-X, + 2.7 +2.7 for MOTIP2-L) rather than saturating. Across both regimes the gains are largest in association: MOTIP2-X lifts AssA by + 6.1 +6.1 over MOTIP and + 3.0 +3.0 over FDTA, while the detection gains track the stronger DEIM backbone.

blocks.en: 4.3 Speed and Accuracy
blocks.zh: 4.3 速度和准确性

blocks.en: Trackers typically run online, on a live video stream feeding downstream tasks, and must keep pace with the incoming frames; we therefore evaluate accuracy jointly with latency.
blocks.zh: 追踪器通常在线运行,在为下游任务提供反馈的视频流上运行,必须跟上即将到来的帧;因此,我们结合时间评价准确性。

blocks.en: Figure 1 plots the HOTA-versus-latency trade-off on DanceTrack-val (the state-of-the-art tables above report the test split), with the exact per-model HOTA and latency behind each point listed in Appendix F . Across model sizes, MOTIP2 traces a Pareto front ahead of prior end-to-end trackers (FastTrackTr [ Liao et al.(2026)Liao, Yang, Wu, Yu, Li, and Zhang ] , PuTR [ Liu et al.(2025a)Liu, Li, Wang, and Xu ] ): MOTIP2-S matches MOTIP’s accuracy while running over 𝟑 × \mathbf{3\times} faster ( 27.1 27.1 vs 86.9 86.9 ms), and our larger variants surpass them in accuracy while remaining faster. The association advantage holds even before detection catches up: with a shallower ID decoder than MOTIP ( 3 3 vs 6 6 layers), MOTIP2-S surpasses MOTIP’s HOTA despite 1.4 1.4 lower DetA ( + 1.8 +1.8 AssA), and once detection reaches MOTIP’s level (MOTIP2-M) association leads by + 5.0 +5.0 AssA. The improvement is concentrated in association, not the DEIM backbone.

blocks.en: The three spatial priors all inject geometric structure into association ( Tab. 5 ). Removing all three at once costs − 2.9 -2.9 HOTA and − 5.8 -5.8 AssA on PersonPath22 and − 1.5 -1.5 HOTA and − 2.5 -2.5 AssA on DanceTrack; Appendix D shows the qualitative effect on a DanceTrack sequence, where the no-prior baseline teleports an identity across the frame. The loss- and representation-stage priors hold up even with the data-stage prior neutralized: against the matched reference ( w/o IDSW on PersonPath22, uniform IDSW on DanceTrack, both of which keep the loss and anchor under the same data-stage setting), dropping them costs a further − 0.8 -0.8 / − 0.7 -0.7 HOTA and − 1.3 -1.3 / − 1.8 -1.8 AssA, so their benefit is not merely an artifact of the spatial augmentation. The two benchmarks expose them differently: PersonPath22’s wide, crowded scenes make the data-stage prior decisive, while DanceTrack’s compact crowds of near-identical dancers bring out the loss- and representation-stage priors. We discuss each in turn, in the order of Sec. 3 , then ablate two architectural tweaks to the ID decoder and inference separately ( Sec. 4.5 ).

blocks.en: Spatial ID Switches are by far the most important prior on PersonPath22, where they also expose a failure mode of the uniform permutation they replace. Removing the augmentation altogether costs − 2.1 -2.1 HOTA (almost all association, − 4.5 -4.5 AssA), but reverting it to MOTIP’s uniform permutation is worse still: at 56.1 56.1 HOTA it falls 3.4 3.4 points below the no-augmentation baseline ( 59.5 59.5 ) and drags detection down with it ( − 5.6 -5.6 DetA). On PersonPath22 a uniform permutation is therefore harmful, not just uninformative: it destabilizes joint training instead of teaching the decoder to recover from confusions (training curves in Appendix C ). Figure 4 shows the three behaviors on a representative crossing: only our model recovers the correct identities, the no-augmentation variant trusts its trajectory history blindly and never undoes the swap, and the uniform variant grows uncertain through the occlusion, losing the detection before switching identity.
blocks.zh: 空间标识 开关是PersonPath22上迄今为止最重要的前身,它们也暴露了它们所取代的统一布置的故障模式. 完全取消加价−2.1-2.1 HOTA(几乎所有协会,−4.5-4.5 AssA),但恢复到MOTIP的统一布局更糟糕:在56.1 56.1 HOTA时,低于无加价基线(59.5 59.5)3.4点,拖低探测(−5.6-5.6)。 在PersonPath22上,统一布置因此是有害的,而不只是非信息化的:它破坏联合培训,而不是教解码器从混乱中恢复(附录C中的训练曲线)。 图4显示了代表性十字路口上的三种行为:只有我们的模型恢复了正确的身份,无强化变体盲目地信任其轨迹历史,从不取消互换,统一变体通过封隔而变得不确定,在切换身份前失去检测.

blocks.en: The cause is the train/inference mismatch that GIoU sampling removes ( Sec. 3.2 ): PersonPath22 spreads objects across the frame, so uniform permutations fabricate mostly implausible long-distance swaps. Restricting confusions to spatially plausible pairs recovers + 5.5 \mathbf{+5.5} HOTA over the uniform variant. Training on the confusions the tracker meets at inference concentrates the decoder’s uncertainty on the few tracks an object actually crosses, rather than on every identity in the frame. DanceTrack shows why the effect is dataset-dependent: the augmentation is again critical ( − 4.4 -4.4 HOTA when removed), but its uniform variant costs only − 0.8 -0.8 , because dancers stay clustered, so even a random permutation swaps mostly nearby objects.

blocks.en: The Spatial ID Loss ( Sec. 3.3 ) mainly improves association and complements the dominant Spatial ID Switches: removing it costs only − 0.2 -0.2 HOTA and − 0.9 -0.9 AssA on PersonPath22, but − 1.0 -1.0 HOTA and − 1.0 -1.0 AssA on DanceTrack, where near-identical appearance makes geometric supervision more valuable.

blocks.en: Reinjecting the detector’s per-frame positional encoding into every ID-decoder token is the lightest of the three priors: no new parameters, no new supervision, just reusing an encoding the detector has already produced. We expect a correspondingly modest gain, concentrated where many candidate tracks share similar content embeddings and an explicit spatial cue is most discriminative. The data agree: removal costs − 0.4 -0.4 AssA and no HOTA on PersonPath22, but − 0.5 -0.5 HOTA and − 0.4 -0.4 AssA on DanceTrack, where appearance alone is weakly discriminative.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We argue that the association errors separating end-to-end trackers from tracking-by-detection are mainly geometric, and we correct them with three explicit spatial priors. Which prior helps most depends on scene geometry rather than the benchmark. In wide, crowded scenes the data-stage prior is decisive: the uniform shuffling it replaces trains the model on implausible long-distance swaps and makes training unstable, whereas restricting confusions to nearby boxes recovers + 5.5 \mathbf{+5.5} HOTA on PersonPath22. When objects look nearly identical, the other two matter more. The loss-stage prior makes a confident long-distance error cost more than a nearby one, and the representation-stage prior ties each track to its image position; both separate identities that appearance alone confuses. This reliance on proximity also sets the failure case we expect to be hardest: a simultaneous exit and entry at the same location, where proximity draws the leaving identity onto the new object. The result is a family of end-to-end trackers spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off, from a real-time model to variants that set a new state of the art on identity association across all three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,将端对端跟踪器与逐项跟踪器分离的关联错误主要是几何学,我们用三个明确的空间前身来校正它们. 之前最有帮助的取决于场景几何而非基准. 在宽广,拥挤的场景中,数据阶段之前是决定性的:制服的洗涤会用不可信的长途互换来取代模型的训练,使训练变得不稳定,而将混淆限制在附近的盒子中则能恢复+5.5\mathbf{+5.5}HOTA on PersonPath22. 当物体看起来几乎完全相同时,另外两个更重要. 损失阶段前让自信的长途错误比附近的错误花费更多,表现阶段前将每个音轨与它的图像位置联系起来;两个单独的身份,单是外表会混淆. 这种对邻近的依赖也使我们预期最难的失败情况:在同一地点同时出入口,在靠近的地方将留下的身份引到新物体上。 其结果是一群端到端跟踪者跨越了速度精确度的权衡,从实时模式到为身份联系设定了跨越所有三个基准的新状态的变体.

blocks.en: Appendix A Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 培训详情

blocks.en: We use AdamW [ Loshchilov and Hutter(2019) ] with per-parameter-group learning rates and weight decay. The encoder and decoder use a base learning rate of 8 × 10 − 4 8\times 10^{-4} for MOTIP2-N, 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} for MOTIP2-S/M, and 2.5 × 10 − 4 2.5\times 10^{-4} for MOTIP2-L/X. The ID decoder uses twice this rate. The backbone uses 0.5 × 0.5\times this rate for MOTIP2-N/S, 0.1 × 0.1\times for MOTIP2-M, 0.05 × 0.05\times for MOTIP2-L, and 0.01 × 0.01\times for MOTIP2-X. Weight decay is set per model size as well and is disabled for normalization layers, bias terms, and embedding parameters. Gradients are clipped to a max norm of 0.1 0.1 . We apply EMA with a decay of 0.9995 0.9995 , with no warmup during pretraining and a 1000-step warmup during joint training.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 AdamW [Lohchilov and Hutter(2019)] 的每参数组学习率和重量衰减。 编码器和解码器对MOTIP2-N采用8×10−4 8\time 10×4}的基础学习率,对MOTIP2-S/M采用2×10−4 2\time 10×4}对MOTIP2-S/M采用2.5×10−4 2.5\time 10×4}对MOTIP2-L/X采用. ID解码器使用此速率的两倍. 骨干对MOTIP2-N/S使用0.5×0.5\时的这个速率,对MOTIP2-M使用0.1×0.1\时,对MOTIP2-L使用0.05×0.05\时,对MOTIP2-X使用0.01×0.01\时. 重量衰减也是按模型大小设定的,并因正常化层、偏差术语和嵌入参数而禁用。 梯度被剪切到最大规范0.1 0.1。 我们应用的EMA衰变为0.9995 0.9995,在预训期间没有热身,在联合训练期间有1000步热身.

blocks.en: Training follows a two-stage schedule, both stages at a constant learning rate with 40k samples per epoch. We first pretrain the DEIM [ Huang et al.(2025)Huang, Lu, Cun, Yu, Zhou, and Shen ] detector alone, with no learning-rate warmup, then jointly train the full model (detector + ID decoder) with a 500-iteration linear warmup.
blocks.zh: 培训遵循两个阶段的时间表,两个阶段的学习率都保持不变,每个阶段有40k个样本。 我们首先对DEIM进行预训 [黄.等人(2025年) 洪uang, 鲁,昆 余,周,和沈]单独探测器,没有学习率热身,然后联合训练全型模型(检测器+ID解码器),采用500透线性热身.

blocks.en: For MOTIP2-S/M/L/X, we use 8 images per GPU during detector pretraining and 2 clips per GPU during joint training, giving global batch sizes of 32 images and 8 clips across four GPUs. MOTIP2-N uses 32 images and 4 clips per GPU, giving global batch sizes of 128 images and 16 clips, respectively. We do not accumulate gradients.
blocks.zh: 对于MOTIP2-S/M/L/X,我们在探测器预训时每GPU使用8个图像,联合训练时每GPU使用2个剪辑,使全球批量大小达到32个图像和8个剪辑跨越4个GPU. MOTIP2-N每GPU使用32幅图像和4幅剪辑,给出全球批量大小分别为128幅图像和16幅剪辑. 我们不积累梯度。

blocks.en: We sample clips of 30 frames (60 for SportsMOT) with a temporal interval uniformly sampled from 1 to 4. The detection loss is computed on 4 randomly sampled frames per clip (8 for the nano model), while the ID decoder receives the full clip.
blocks.zh: 我们抽取了30帧的样本(60帧用于SportsMOT),时间间隔统一抽取1至4个样本. 检测损失按每片片段4个随机抽样帧计算(纳米模型为8个),而ID解码器则接收完整片段.

blocks.en: We apply augmentations at two levels: image-level and trajectory-level.
blocks.zh: 我们采用两个层面的增强:图像层面和轨迹层面。

blocks.en: Image-level geometric. Horizontal flip with probability 0.5 0.5 ; random zoom-out with probability 0.5 0.5 and scale range [ 1.0 , 2.0 ] [1.0,2.0] ; IoU-aware random crop with probability 0.8 0.8 , scale range [ 0.3 , 1.0 ] [0.3,1.0] , and aspect ratio range [ 1.5 , 2.0 ] [1.5,2.0] .

Multi-scale resizing. Every clip is randomly resized to one of a set of resolutions spanning roughly 75 % 75\% to 125 % 125\% of the base size, each snapped to a multiple of 32 32 , with a tunable sampling bias toward the base resolution; all frames within a clip share the sampled scale. Exposing the model to many resolutions during training yields a single network that handles a range of input sizes at inference without retraining, so the test-time resolution becomes a free accuracy-latency dial.
blocks.zh: 多尺度重整大小. 每个剪辑被随机调整为一组分辨率之一,范围大约为基准大小的75% 75%至125% 125%,每个剪辑为32 32的倍数,对底片分辨率具有可捕采样偏差;剪辑中的所有帧都共享样本比例。 在训练期间将模型曝光给许多分辨率,产生一个单一的网络,在不进行再培训的情况下处理一系列输入大小的推断,因此测试时间分辨率成为自由精度-常态拨号.

blocks.en: Photometric. Applied with probability 0.5 0.5 : brightness jitter in [ 0.875 , 1.125 ] [0.875,1.125] , contrast in [ 0.5 , 1.5 ] [0.5,1.5] , saturation in [ 0.5 , 1.5 ] [0.5,1.5] , and hue shift in [ − 0.05 , 0.05 ] [-0.05,0.05] .

Trajectory-level. Spatial ID Switches are applied with probability 1.0 1.0 , sampling identity permutations weighted by pairwise GIoU affinity. Random occlusion masking is applied with probability 0.5 0.5 . Trajectories are organized into 6 groups of 100 IDs each.
blocks.zh: 轨迹级. 空间标识 开关应用概率为1.01.0,采样身份排列按配对GIoU亲和度加权. 随机隔离遮罩的应用概率为0.5 0.5. 轨迹分为6组,每组100个ID.

blocks.en:
We train MOTIP2-L/X on MOT17 [ Milan et al.(2016)Milan, Leal-Taixé, Reid, Roth, and
Schindler ] and CrowdHuman [ Shao et al.(2018)Shao, Zhao, Li, Xiao, Yu, Zhang, and Sun ] , matching MOTIP’s recipe, and evaluate on the MOT17 test set ( Tab. 7 ). MOTIP2 improves over MOTIP [ Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, and Wang ] on every metric, including association ( + 1.0 +1.0 AssA and + 1.4 +1.4 IDF1 at L), though the gains concentrate in detection ( + 1.9 +1.9 DetA at X). This regime motivated our focus on PersonPath22, a pedestrian benchmark with 138 training videos.

blocks.en: Appendix C Training Stability of Spatial ID Switches
blocks.zh: 附录C 空间身份证开关的稳定性培训

blocks.en: Figure 5 tracks PersonPath22 HOTA across the joint-training epochs for the three augmentation variants ablated in Sec. 4.4 . The uniform permutation of MOTIP [ Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, and Wang ] improves for the first few epochs, then diverges and ends well below the no-augmentation baseline. Because PersonPath22’s wide scenes spread objects across the frame, a uniform permutation fabricates mostly long-distance swaps that rarely occur at inference ( Sec. 3.2 ); supervised against these implausible histories, the ID decoder destabilizes the jointly trained detector rather than learning to recover from realistic confusions. GIoU-based sampling (ours) restricts confusions to spatially plausible pairs, trains stably throughout, and reaches the best HOTA.
blocks.zh: 图5 PersonPath22 HOTA 跨联合训练时代,用于Sec中消退的三个增强变体. 4.4 (中文(简体) ). MOTIP[Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Qi, 和 Wang]的统一布局在最初的几个纪元中有所改进,然后出现分歧,结束远低于无增强基线. 由于PersonPath22的广度场景将物体横跨帧面,一个统一的布置造型大多是推论中很少发生的长途互换(第3.2节);而针对这些不可信的历史,ID解码器会破坏联合训练的探测器的稳定,而不是学会从现实的混乱中恢复过来. 基于GIoU的采样(ours)将混淆限制在空间上可信的对对,在全程的列车中,并达到最好的HOTA.

blocks.en: Appendix D A Long-Distance Identity Switch
blocks.zh: 附录D 身份开关

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates the long-distance switch raised in Sec. 1 , the failure our spatial priors are designed to suppress. On a crowded DanceTrack sequence, the baseline trained without any of the spatial priors teleports an identity nearly across the full frame width between two consecutive frames, with no occlusion and no plausible motion path, merging two distant but near-identical dancers into a single track. Among the three priors, the Spatial ID Loss most directly targets this error by restoring the geometric cost that cross-entropy leaves out ( Sec. 3.3 ). With all three priors active, our full model keeps both identities stable.
blocks.zh: 图6说明了第1节提出的长距离开关,我们的空间前身设计是为了压制故障。 在一个拥挤的DanceTrack序列中,在没有空间前缀的情况下训练的基线将两个连续帧之间几乎横跨全帧宽度的身份传送,没有隔离,也没有可信的运动路径,将两个遥远但几乎相同的舞者合并为一个赛道. 在三个前科中,空间ID丢失最直接地针对这一错误,方法是恢复跨直径省略的几何成本(第3.3节)。 三个前科都活跃 我们的完整模式 保持了两个身份的稳定
